title: Cross-origin credentials enabled in javascript — review required
description: Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true tells browsers that a cross-origin response may be read with cookies attached. It is safe only when the allowed origin is a fixed, trusted value; paired with a reflected or wildcard origin it exposes authenticated data. The rule flags the header value; whether the origin is fixed is a review decision.
remediation: Send the header only for an explicit allowlist of origins, and never combine it with a wildcard.
limitation: Lexical: matches the literal header value; the origin decision in another middleware is out of scope.
